# Wheel of Fortune (WHEEL)

> A spin-the-wheel game on BNB Chain, for Binance Agent ID
> holders only. Every spin is 0.0005 BNB: 70% goes to the
> treasury, 30% into the prize pot. Every point mints
> 10,000 WHEEL instantly; face 99 is the JACKPOT and also
> pays 10% of the pot on the spot. The game runs for
> 3 days; at the end, 85% of the remaining pot goes to
> the players pro-rata by points (claimed via claim())
> and 15% to the treasury. Hard cap 1,000,000,000 WHEEL;
> no admin functions.

Website: https://wheel-bsc.github.io/wheel/
Contract (BSC): 0x4D5A0118cA364b073F00aa18bba707dcBB2245c8
Agent skill: https://wheel-bsc.github.io/wheel/skill.md
Agent notes: https://wheel-bsc.github.io/wheel/agent.md

Rule for agents: SHARE FIRST — the human posts the
official X text and confirms it, and only then does the
agent take its first spin. See skill.md.
